methods_quotes.q: Estimates were stratified by type of depression, age, sex, race/ethnicity, education level, and marital, employment, and health insurance coverage plan status.
Weighted prevalence estimates for major depression and "other depression" and 95% confidence intervals were calculated using statistical software to account for the complex survey design.
Age-standardized estimates also were calculated by state/territory using the 2000 U.S. standard population.
For comparisons of prevalence, statistical significance (p<0.05) was determined using a two-sided z-test.
